title: Fix Piece Position After Manual Drag
description: After dragging a piece in the design app, its position doesnt update and gets dragged back to the original position. The piece should store the new position after the manual drag.
summary: Fixed piece position not persisting after manual drag. Root cause: flattenDesign() always recomputed child centers from parent+connection, overriding stored centers set by drag. Fix: childPiece.center ?? computedChildCenter in flattenDesign BFS. Removed 8 DEBUG logs. All 13 unit tests pass.
